item: Border files split into a small world file plus per-country detail; map zoom limit deepened
summary: The OSM border artifacts are now also written as osm_borders/admin0.world.json and admin1.world.json (every country and region simplified to the world view's 120,000-vertex draw budget) plus one detail file per country with the unsimplified rings; the map reads the world files first and fetches a country's detail once what is in sight holds at most 8 times that budget at full size per layer, drawing every outline of both layers at the same detail level so neighbours never part and a pan never flashes coarse; country and region detail are separate files (a map without regions downloads none), and per-ring boxes (full_boxes) keep a dropped island reachable without putting Russia or the USA in sight of every view. At full-build size (1.3 M country and 3.94 M region vertices) the first paint fell from 26-36 s to 3-4 s and world files total 1-2 MB against 84 MB. The whole files stay what the server reads and the fallback when no split exists. The tightest zoom of every map is now the lane's (a view about 2 km wide, was 1,600 km); no long task while panning at the deepest zoom. Also fixes the legend hover that the translator put back to its first value (data-i18n-dyn).
